mapper.select: SELECT 'FARM_AUDIT' AS queue, COUNT(*) AS count, MIN(submitted_at) AS earliest_at, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN submitted_at < #{overdueBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_count FROM t_farm_audit WHERE status = 'PENDING' UNION ALL SELECT 'FARM_CHANGE', COUNT(*), MIN(created_at), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at < #{overdueBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM t_farm_change WHERE status = 'PENDING' UNION ALL SELECT 'CHANGE_REQUEST', COUNT(*), MIN(submitted_at), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN submitted_at < #{overdueBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM t_change_request WHERE status = 'PENDING' UNION ALL SELECT 'ACCOUNT_RECOVERY', COUNT(*), MIN(created_at), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at < #{overdueBefore} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM t_account_recovery WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND new_phone_verified_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_change_request WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND impact_sellable_date = 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fc.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, MIN(CASE WHEN fc.status = 'PENDING' THEN fc.created_at END) AS earliest_at, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fc.status = 'APPROVED' AND fc.audited_at >= #{since} AND fc.audited_at <= #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved_30d, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fc.status = 'APPROVED' AND fc.audited_at >= #{since} AND fc.audited_at <= #{now} AND fc.name_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved_by_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fc.status = 'APPROVED' AND fc.audited_at >= #{since} AND fc.audited_at <= #{now} AND fc.address_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved_by_address, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fc.status = 'APPROVED' AND fc.audited_at >= #{since} AND fc.audited_at <= #{now} AND fc.qual_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved_by_qualification, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fc.status = 'REJECTED' AND fc.audited_at >= #{since} AND fc.audited_at <= #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected_30d FROM t_farm_change fc JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = fc.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 JOIN t_user u ON u.id = f.owner_user_id
AND (f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR (#{keyword} REGEXP '^[0-9]{11}$' AND u.phone = #{keyword}))
AND fc.name_changed = 1 AND fc.address_changed = 1 AND fc.qual_changed = 1
SELECT * FROM t_farm_change WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT f.id AS farm_id, f.name AS farm_name, m.role AS role, GROUP_CONCAT(p.pen_name ORDER BY p.id SEPARATOR '、') AS pen_text FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_member_pen mp ON mp.member_id = m.id AND mp.farm_id = m.farm_id LEFT JOIN t_pen p ON p.id = mp.pen_id AND p.farm_id = mp.farm_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY f.id, f.name, m.role ORDER BY f.id

SELECT l.id AS id, l.created_at AS checked_at, l.old_phone AS old_phone, l.result AS result, l.remaining_attempts AS remaining_attempts, l.lock_until AS lock_until, l.submit_channel AS submit_channel, l.proxy_admin_id AS proxy_admin_id, a.name AS proxy_admin_name FROM t_recovery_verify_log l LEFT JOIN t_admin a ON a.id = l.proxy_admin_id WHERE (l.user_id = #{userId} OR l.old_phone = #{oldPhone}) ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
